tools.name: discover_events
tools.description: Search FeedIRL for upcoming real-world events and experiences by location, date window, budget, and interests/vibe. Returns ranked results with a one-line reason, local start time when known, price when available, source, referral ticket link, and last-verified timestamp. Discovery only — send peopl

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discover_events · Public sink: discover_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: discover_events · Public sink: discover_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
